outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes (N=4, n>100), but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (N=4, n>400), but no individual data points are shown.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot showing averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks); line plots are exempt from the requirement to overlay individual data points.
Panel E consists of line plots (rotarod performance across days at three time points); line plots are exempt from needing individual data points.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (a line plot type); such plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G shows only micrograph images (Calbindin, DAPI, Merge) with no accompanying quantification plot in this panel, so the check does not apply.
Panel H contains two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number, N=3, n=9) showing mean ± SD, but individual data points are not overlaid on either bar chart.
